span.p: 1. YOU: Set priorities or share leads

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3. Verify full live JD; deduplicate;
map evidence and confirmed answers

div.style: color: rgb(51, 33, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3a. YOU: Supply a missing fact
or resolve a conflicting preference

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
4. Score exact evidence using configured rubric;
obtain independent reviews

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5. Gate: configured threshold
and required reviewers approve

div.style: color: rgb(89, 19, 35) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5a. Otherwise park or hold here;
resolve disagreements within this phase

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6. Check shared-route stops,
applications and reservations

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
7. Save qualified JD privately;
verify builder handoff packet

div.style: color: rgb(89, 19, 35) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
8. Build one package from approved evidence
and the chosen master layout

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
9. Validate exact PDF;
obtain independent resume reviews

div.style: color: rgb(89, 19, 35) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p: 9a. Fix and recheck inside this phase

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(51, 33, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
11. YOU: Approve this exact PDF
or request revisions

div.style: color: rgb(51, 33, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
12. Record exact approved artifact
Not permission to apply or send

div.style: color: rgb(89, 19, 35) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
11a. Revalidate revisions
and return for your approval

div.style: color: rgb(51, 33, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
13. YOU: Authorize the specific application,
upload or outreach
